title: Disk space: df and du
summary: How full the disk is, and which folder takes the room.

scheme: Filesystem  Size  Used Avail Use% Mounted on
text: df shows how full each filesystem is: size, used, left. With a path (/ here), only the one that holds it. -h writes G and M instead of bytes.
- Above 90%, act before it's full: programs fail in strange ways at 100%.
du measures folders. -s gives one total per folder.
- sort -h sorts 1.2G and 28G correctly, tail keeps the biggest.
- Go down one level at a time until you find the culprit.

scheme: └── home/sam/     a big file you forgot
text: - Logs: sudo journalctl --vacuum-size=200M trims the journal.
- Caches: sudo apt clean (or sudo dnf clean all).
